claim: For the Heawood graph \(H\), presented as the incidence graph of the Fano plane with its shortest-path metric, \(\dim_{\mathbb F_2}\operatorname{MH}_{3,4}(H;\mathbb F_2)=336\).

correctness.rationale: The stated Fano-incidence graph is reconstructed directly. At length 4 the verifier independently obtains chain dimensions 840, 2268, and 1134, computes boundary ranks 840 and 1092 by two elimination orientations, checks every composition column for ∂3∂4=0, and therefore obtains 2268-840-1092=336. The claim is explicitly limited to F_2 and one bidegree.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the canonical Fano-plane incidence graph and a highly symmetric girth-six example. Bidegree (3,4) is the first off-diagonal exactly beyond the checked girth-vanishing threshold for girth six, and nongeodeticity places it outside the later exact geodetic theory. The exact rank 336 is therefore a natural benchmark at a structural boundary rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
